answer: Like mycelium forming fruiting bodies only where subterranean hyphae weave deep root trusts, decentralized consensus crystallizes economic reality. An isolated rogue island cannot mint consensus: proof of collaborative stake enforces that forging fraudulent identities incurs superlinear attacker cost. A solitary sparrow carries merely a copper token, but scaling duplicate swarms demands combinatorial staking bonds, choking impostors before they spread.
